verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing mentions custom monitoring policies with instant alerts and remote script execution, plus automating recurring fixes and the ability to 'identify, notify, and fix' compliance drift. Together these imply event-triggered, policy-driven actions within the product. The evidence is thin pricing-page and homepage copy, with no documentation of how rules are authored or what actions they can trigger. missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition model, explicit event-to-action automation (e.g., auto-running scripts on alert conditions), in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
